findings.finding: Exact S fluoroisoindolinone junction independently matches original CN A-1-1c and US scheme to JCI; full route connectivity is publicly specified but end-to-end BLU identity and purity not demonstrated.
findings.decision: Use CN pathway as first route-development basis, US alternative; freeze release specification, not silently corrected recipe.

findings.finding: JCI v2 page 14 labels the enzyme PV3574l; Thermo identifies PV3574 as buffer and PV5374 as the C2B enzyme.
findings.decision: Qualify an independently declared construct. Do not assert that investigators used buffer or definitively identify their actual enzyme.

findings.finding: Printed 150 nM PI / 60 nM enzyme = 2.5 substrate molecules per enzyme; maximum productive ADP equals 0.015% of 1 mM ATP. Reported 28 nM IC50 is near half the nominal enzyme concentration.
findings.decision: Validate units and initial-rate/detection window. Do not substitute micromolar units, a free Ki, or a universal IC50 acceptance band.

findings.finding: Two NCI C2B direct-PRM assays and an original SOP provide an antibody-independent detection starting point in SUM159 digest.
findings.decision: Qualify actual muscle matrix and PRM-CETSA feasibility; do not claim fractional occupancy or a guaranteed thermal shift.

findings.finding: Exact compound 47 is the first comparator; 91 is conditional fallback. Neither has established exact-article XLMTM function or cellular pS6K proof in the inspected patent.
findings.decision: Match identity, exposure and target modulation before functional comparison.
